description: Per-namespace retrieval-verification dataset for the uniswap namespace (2 live tools). Every live tool has blind rows (no brand word) and protocol-aware rows (brand named). Queries were written from the manifests and the navigation entry only, phrased the way a model would type them into tool search on the user's behalf. THE THREE CO-RETRIEVAL ROWS - "swap tokens on Base, what would I get", "swap 100 USDC into ETH on Arbitrum, price it first" and "best price for a token swap on an EVM chain" - appear VERBATIM in the sibling kyberswap dataset, each expecting its OWN namespace's quote tool. That pairing is how co-retrieval is asserted here: the validator refuses an expectation outside the declared namespace (`namespace-dataset.ts`), so a single row naming both venues is not expressible, and two rows over one query are. Together they say a blind swap query must return BOTH venues' quote tools in the top 5, which is what the 2026-09-07 equal-standing decision means for discovery; D11 already ruled the two ranking together the desired outcome. The Robinhood Chain rows cover the coverage this venue uniquely serves.
